worked_solution:
Using the identity $1+{cot}^{2}⁡z={csc}^{2}⁡z,$ we rewrite and simplify the expression as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{cos}^{2}⁡z\,({cot}^{2}⁡z+1) & ={cos}^{2}⁡z\cdot {csc}^{2}⁡z \\  & ={cos}^{2}⁡z\cdot {(\frac{1}{\operatorname{sin}⁡z})}^{2} \\  & ={cos}^{2}⁡z\cdot \frac{1}{{sin}^{2}⁡z} \\  & =\frac{{cos}^{2}⁡z}{{sin}^{2}⁡z} \\  & ={(\frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡z}{\operatorname{sin}⁡z})}^{2} \\  & ={cot}^{2}⁡z\end{aligned}
$$
